column1: # TripPrintables round seven: niche-native competitor check | pulled 2026-09-15 | Ahrefs API v3 site-explorer-organic-keywords

# Same method as round four (which checked gdoc.io in round two and smartertravel.com/justagirlandherblog.com in round four). Domains selected here recurred most often as top-ranking pages across round five's 98-keyword SERP sweep.

column4: CLOSEST ANALOG - still not a specialist
column5: Itinerary template #3 by volume (59000/mo), packing list #5, travel packing list #27, vacation packing list #32 all appear in top 40 - by far the highest density of any domain checked across all rounds (vs ~5% for gdoc.io/smartertravel/justagirlandherblog). But top keywords are dominated by general destination-guide content (door county wisconsin, missoula montana, glacier park, saugatuck, cathedral rock, sedona) and travel-tool terms (autoslash, insuremytrip, flytographer, google flights explore) - a travel blog that covers itinerary/packing well, not a printables-identity site.

column4: NOT A SPECIALIST - confirms gdoc.io pattern
column5: Same 'everything template mill' structure as gdoc.io: invoice template (88000/mo), resume templates (62000), google slides themes (28000), budget spreadsheet, cornell notes, family tree, fake doctors note, checklist template, brochure, menu template, missing poster template all rank above itinerary template (16000, position 14/40). Travel is a minor category in a general office/school-document business.

column4: NOT A SPECIALIST - general travel publisher
column5: Top 40 is almost entirely destination-guide content (copenhagen 210000/mo, dolomites 146000, oaxaca 111000, best beaches in portugal 63000, ljubljana, antigua guatemala, busan, french riviera, seoul korea) with real scale - this is a large successful general travel blog, not a niche site. Packing list (22000, position 5) and how to pack a suitcase (56000, position 13) are real categories but a small slice of a much bigger destination-guide business, same structural pattern as smartertravel.com in round four.
